name: CAP blue flight jacket (worn with the CFDU) with blank nametag
size_basis: THE BODY IS THE CFDU'S (owner, 2026-11-10: "jacket should be same size as the fdu"): shoulder points, sleeves, cuff line and chest patch positions are the suit's (flight-body.js: CAPR 39-1 Figure 8.1 scaled so the front zipper is 28 in), so the same body is the same size in both; the jacket is the suit's upper body cut off at the waist with knit collar, waistband and cuffs. CAPR 39-1 6.1.7 says the blue flight jacket is "similar to the MA-1 or CWU-45/P or -36/P flight jackets in design and construction" (Figure 6.6: navy, orange lining, gold zipper, knit collar/waist/cuffs, left sleeve pocket); the MA-1 details are carried over: back length 22 1/2 in, flap 7 1/2 x 2 3/8 in, sleeve pocket 5 3/4 x 3 1/4 in (MIL-J-8279G size Medium, an ASSUMPTION for the blue jacket). The MIL-J chest 26, bottom 23 1/2 and sleeve inseam 16 3/8 in are not used. Collar and knit heights are estimates.

dimension_sources.body_shoulders_sleeves_cuff_line: the Flight Duty Uniform body (flight-body.js, CAPR 39-1 Figure 8.1 x KF, owner instruction 2026-11-10)

flag.drawn: in the garment image (flat sleeve view and, clipped to the arm, the front view)
flag.position: 1/2 in below the shoulder seam, measured from the arched seam at the sleeve centre line (flat sleeve view); front view: the foreshortened face (1.82 of its 3.5 in, as the FDU front view) is tilted with the sleeve centre line and hung so that the canton lies whole on the sleeve, 0.06 in clear of the armhole seam, its nearest corner 1/2 in from the seam top; the outer part wraps round the arm and is clipped by the outline (the loop square on the right sleeve is placed the same way)
flag.orientation: normal: canton (union) toward the wearer's front / the viewer's left on the outer face of the left sleeve; the reversed flag is for the right sleeve, which this reg does not give a flag
flag.basis: CAPR 39-1 8.2.4.4 / 8.3.4.4 (left sleeve only); orientation convention per DAFI 36-2903 (flag worn so the union leads forward; reversed on the right shoulder)
flag.loop_tape_left: not drawn: the 3 1/2 in loop tape on the left is the same colour as the garment and invisible
flag.loop_square_right: drawn as the right-sleeve patch slot (8.2.5.5 / 8.3.5.5)

optional_landmarks.pen_pocket_left: cigarette/pencil pocket on the left sleeve (MA-1 spec)
optional_landmarks.es_patch_zone: optional patch; the jacket is configured like the FDU/CFDU (8.2.7.1 / 6.1.7)
optional_landmarks.grade_zone_left: officers only (8.2.3.2 / 8.3.3.2 / 6.1.7); NCOs and cadets wear no grade

zipper_note: 8.2.7.1: flight jackets are required to be zipped at least halfway; anchors.zipper_min_closed is that height. The artwork shows it fully closed.
views_note: Front view plus a flat view of each sleeve (flag and pocket on the left, loop-tape slot on the right), as for the FDU; a presentation decision, not a regulation requirement.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; polygons are [[x,y]...]; user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box. Right/left = wearer's. Zones with no artwork are invisible placement landmarks.

sheet_alignment.note: Jacket and both flat sleeve panels share one top line (collar top = top of the arch) and one bottom line (jacket cuff bottom = panel cuff bottom). Y in artwork-box inches.
sheet_alignment.flat_sleeve_length_source: ESTIMATE: jacket cuff bottom up to the corner line under the arch, the suit's flat sleeve (same width table and position); the sleeve outer edge measures 35.0 in along the edge (OUT, the suit's)
sheet_alignment.symmetry: silhouette, sleeves, cuffs, collar, waistband and flap pockets are one half mirrored about the zip line (audit-flight.js checks it to 0.05 in); only the patches differ side to side

documented: blue flight jacket is an authorized outer garment with the CFDU (8.3.7) and is similar to the MA-1 / CWU-45/P / CWU-36/P in design and construction (6.1.7, Figure 6.6)
nametag (black leather or blue cloth) on the left breast, CAP Command Patch on the right breast, other CFDU patches optional (6.1.7)

accoutrements follow the CFDU: Command Patch right breast opposite the nametag, US flag 2 x 3 1/2 in on the left sleeve 1/2 in below the seam, authorized patch on a 3 1/2 x 3 1/2 in square of black loop tape on the right sleeve (8.3.4, 8.3.5.5)
grade for officers on top of each shoulder, bottom edge 1/2 in from the seam; general officer stars centred on the shoulder halfway between neck and seam (8.3.3.1, 8.3.3.2)
assumed: finished measurements of the blue jacket are not given (6.1.7 only says similar design and construction): the body is the CFDU's and the MA-1 Medium back length, flap and sleeve pocket are used
navy shade sampled from the Figure 6.6 illustration (the owner doubts it, 2026-11-10: candidates are on the colour sheet; not changed)
ES patch zone position (jacket has no breast pocket)
